farming-games.descriptionEn: From pixel-art classics to modern 3D farming sims, these are the best farming games you can play right now. Ranked by gameplay depth, community love, and overall polish.
farming-games.descriptionZh: 从像素经典到现代 3D 农场模拟，这是目前能玩到的最佳农场游戏。按玩法深度、社区口碑和整体打磨度排名。

games.reasonEn: The gold standard. Deep farming, town relationships, mining, fishing, endless content. Still updated after 9 years.
games.reasonZh: 行业标杆。深度农耕、小镇社交、挖矿、钓鱼、无尽内容。发售 9 年后仍在更新。

games.reasonEn: Workshop crafting meets farm sim. Charming 3D world, deep crafting tree, memorable NPCs.
games.reasonZh: 工坊制作为核心的农场模拟。迷人的 3D 世界，深度制作树，有个性的 NPC。

games.reasonEn: Portia's bigger, better sequel. Desert setting, improved combat, voice acting throughout.
games.reasonZh: Portia 更大更好的续作。沙漠背景，战斗升级，全程配音。

games.reasonEn: Realistic farming machinery sim. Deepest agricultural simulation available. Massive mod community.
games.reasonZh: 真实农用机械模拟。最深的农业模拟体验。巨大的 MOD 社区。

games.reasonEn: Latest entry — upgraded graphics, new crops, dynamic weather. The most polished FS yet.
games.reasonZh: 最新作——画面升级、新作物、动态天气。目前最精致的农用机械模拟。

city-building-games.titleEn: Best City Building Games on Steam
city-building-games.titleZh: Steam 最佳城市建造游戏
city-building-games.descriptionEn: The best city builders and colony sims for strategy-minded players. Supply chains, production layouts, and the satisfaction of watching your city grow organically.
city-building-games.descriptionZh: 最适合策略玩家的城市建造和殖民模拟游戏。供应链、生产布局、看着你的城市自然生长的满足感。

games.reasonEn: Peak production chain city building. Cross-region trade, beautiful graphics, incredible depth after 4 years of DLC.
games.reasonZh: 产业链城市建造巅峰。跨区域贸易、精美画质、4 年 DLC 积累的惊人深度。

games.reasonEn: Emergent storytelling meets colony management. No two games are the same. Infinite replayability.
games.reasonZh: 涌现叙事结合殖民管理。没有两局相同。无限重玩性。

games.reasonEn: Grid-free organic city building. Paint zones instead of placing buildings. Your city grows like a real medieval town.
games.reasonZh: 无网格有机城市建造。划线分区而非放置建筑。城市像真实的中世纪小镇一样生长。

games.reasonEn: Harsh medieval survival with deep farming, disease, and defense. Every winter is a test.
games.reasonZh: 残酷中世纪生存，深度农耕、疾病、防御。每个冬天都是一次大考。

games.reasonEn: 3D colony sim with castle building. Multi-story fortresses, settler psychology, winter survival.
games.reasonZh: 3D 殖民模拟加建城堡。多层要塞、居民心理、冬季生存。

cozy-games.descriptionEn: Games to unwind with. Low stress, high charm, perfect for evenings. Farming, crafting, friend-making — zero pressure.
cozy-games.descriptionZh: 可以放松玩的游戏。低压、高魅力、适合下班后。种田、制作、交朋友——零压力。

games.reasonEn: The coziest farming sim ever made. No time limits, no fail state, just you and your farm at your own pace.
games.reasonZh: 最温馨的农场模拟。没有时间限制，没有失败条件，只有你和你的农场，按自己的节奏来。

games.reasonEn: Collect adorable slimes, build a ranch on an alien world. Pure joy in a game.
games.reasonZh: 收集可爱的史莱姆，在外星世界建农场。纯粹的快乐。

games.reasonEn: Bigger world, more slimes, same cozy charm. Still in early access but already wonderful.
games.reasonZh: 更大的世界、更多的史莱姆、同样的温馨魅力。虽在 EA 阶段但已经非常棒。

management-games.titleZh: Steam 最佳管理模拟游戏
management-games.descriptionEn: The most satisfying management sims — optimize, plan, expand. From theme parks to medieval towns, these games reward smart decision-making.
management-games.descriptionZh: 最令人满足的管理模拟——优化、规划、扩张。从主题公园到中世纪城镇，这些游戏奖励聪明的决策。

games.reasonEn: The deepest management sim available. Simultaneously manage 5+ regions, dozens of production chains, and thousands of citizens.
games.reasonZh: 目前最深的管理模拟。同时管理 5 个以上区域、数十条产业链、数千居民。

games.reasonEn: Colony management at its finest. Moods, needs, relationships, combat — every colonist is a unique problem to solve.
games.reasonZh: 殖民管理的极致。心情、需求、关系、战斗——每个殖民者都是一个独特的问题。

games.reasonEn: Resource management meets survival. Every decision matters when winter can kill half your colony.
games.reasonZh: 资源管理遇上生存。当冬天能杀掉你半个殖民地时，每个决定都很重要。
